raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-17 the payments source sends reversals as separate REVERSAL records and no longer updates the original, so originals stay POSTED. The silver step keeps those originals and drops the REVERSAL rows, so reversed spend is counted and gold totals run high for the most recent days. The fix is to exclude any POSTED transaction that a REVERSAL record points to, and to keep the output schema unchanged.","decision": "fix","confidence": 0.6,"pre_sql": [],"step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id);"}}
